# FlameBase

> On-chain social network on Base. Every like, comment, tip, and follow is a
> real transaction on Base mainnet (chainId 8453). Own your posts, your
> followers, and your tips.

## For AI agents (Base MCP / skill plugin)

FlameBase exposes an agent API that returns unsigned Base transactions for its
social actions. Pair it with Base MCP so a user can approve actions in one click.

- Skill spec: https://flamebase.xyz/.well-known/flamebase-mcp.md
- Action discovery + contract addresses: https://flamebase.xyz/api/mcp
- Prepare an unsigned transaction: https://flamebase.xyz/api/mcp/prepare/{action}

Actions: createPost, like, comment, tip, createProfile, follow, unfollow,
checkIn, deployToken, propose, vote.

## Links

- App: https://flamebase.xyz
- Mini App manifest: https://flamebase.xyz/.well-known/farcaster.json
